name: Falling snow
desc: Snow drifts down the app while you chat. It never blocks a click.
author: Yapnap
css: .app::after{content:"";position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:-120%;height:240%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9000;background-image:radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 120px 80px,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(2.5px 2.5px at 200px 140px,#fff,transparent),radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 60px 190px,#fff,transparent);background-size:240px 240px;opacity:.85;animation:ym-snow 16s linear infinite}@keyframes ym-snow{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(240px)}}
